0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000010_SOULEATER
0.description: My feast...must not end... My feast...must not be interrupted!

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000015_SOULEATER
1.description: My feast...must not end... My feast...must not be interrupted!

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000030_PANDAEMONIUM
3.description: From countless failures have I wrought miracles. Into soulless vessels, I breathe life!

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000040_THEMIS
4.description: I suppose I have Athena to thank for this incarnation. I have long considered how I might stand against you, I admit.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000050_THEMIS
5.description: In transformation I present to you my truth. I am Elidibus!

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000060_ATHENA
6.description: You have done well to reach the seat of godhood. Now, bare your souls to me!

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000070_THEMIS
7.description: ...I see. Then Hephaistos's story has been laid bare.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000080_THEMIS
8.description: As has the nature of our mysterious crystal. The questions which led us into Pandæmonium are answered, and soon order shall be restored.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000090_THEMIS
9.description: I, too, can fade away, unburdened by regret. I could not have reached this point without you, friend.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000110_THEMIS
11.description: So many revelations, but there are more, if you would dig a little deeper.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000120_THEMIS
12.description: Elidibus's soul was plucked from the aetherial sea, and from it I was wrought. Surely you have a passing interest in what I remember. In what I feel...

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000130_THEMIS
13.description: You deserve what answers I can provide. While my memories of Pandæmonium are clear, all else is...hazy at best.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000140_THEMIS
14.description: Perhaps Athena made me this way, or...perhaps it is the result of who or what I was before.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000150_THEMIS
15.description: Still, I can recall vague figures. Scenes from my future, and your past...

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000160_THEMIS
16.description: At the Crystal Tower's peak we clash. And later, from that selfsame spire, I send you forth...

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000180_THEMIS
18.description: Why do I decide on such a course? Formless as these images are, I cannot say...

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000200_THEMIS
20.description: Somewhere within my fragmented memories, I catch a glimpse of our journey into Pandæmonium.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000210_THEMIS
21.description: A glimpse which shows not the path we took or the destination where it led us, yet by its very presence demands that you are required in Elpis.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000220_THEMIS
22.description: And even if that act is but one link in the chain of events which ends in Etheirys's salvation...

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000230_THEMIS
23.description: Then this all has meaning. Our time together─every moment─is worthwhile...

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000240_THEMIS
25.description: That said, it is possible my motivations become something else entirely.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000250_THEMIS
26.description: That you would cross this vast expanse in the hopes of being reunited with your allies...

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000260_THEMIS
27.description: A devotion that once would have baffled me. But after having been to the depths of that twisted prison and back, I think I can understand.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000270_THEMIS
28.description: Now, I have pulled back the curtain as far as I dare.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000280_THEMIS
29.description: The people of your age call this the aetherial sea─a name I quite enjoy. For it teems with life, each star a soul on its journey.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000290_THEMIS
30.description: And among these uncountable stars, it was yours that crossed my path. For that I shall be forever grateful.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000300_THEMIS
31.description: I wish you well on your journey. A journey as long as your star is bright─a journey not bound by the confines of this world, or any other.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000310_ELIDIBUS
32.description: How fascinating, the truths that dwell at the edge of sleep.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000320_ELIDIBUS
33.description: The course of history is set by its victors. It is immutable. And yet...

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06401_000330_ELIDIBUS
34.description: Should this star continue upon its path...
